contract: ../design-contract.md: quantitative lunar explorer, truthful ephemerides, explicit geometric horizon, responsive desktop/mobile layouts.

accessibility.evidence: All inputs/selects have programmatic labels. Keyboard ArrowRight on the time range advanced the visible UTC hour; :focus-visible was true with a 2px outline. Charts have text alternatives. Reduced-motion CSS is present and automatic playback is off. Muted/body/mint text contrast against the main background exceeds 4.5:1. Mobile controls were visually checked; no viewport overflow.

responsive.evidence: Browser viewport emulation confirmed 1440x900 and 390x844. documentElement.scrollWidth did not exceed innerWidth. Mobile controls stack, metrics use two columns, and the comparison table scrolls within its container. Removed a chart annotation that overlapped the Earth label on mobile.

loading.evidence: Submitting a scenario immediately sets aria-busy=true and displays calculation status while disabling calculation/comparison controls.

empty.evidence: Setting clearance to 10 degrees at Polar site A showed no simultaneous visibility and actionable date/site/clearance guidance.

error.evidence: Injected upstream 502 in the browser: error message appeared and previous results remained displayed. Restored fetch and demo reset recovered successfully.

partial.evidence: Used a live 16–23 December scenario and injected a 502 only for Polar site B during comparison. Two successful rows remained visible, the failing row was unavailable, and status reported one unavailable site. Restored networking and reset after the test.

success.evidence: Three bundled references load and compare. Scrubbing changes time, opening an equatorial comparison changes active site, invalid latitude is rejected. Live custom -88N/15E and new December dates returned 169 samples. Captured CSV download contained 722 lines including its header.

permission.reason: The application has no account, browser permission, or external write operation. Downloads are generated locally.

renderedEvidence.observation: Desktop first viewport: scenario controls, selected site, Sun/Earth angles, horizon view, and timeline. No horizontal overflow or overlapping labels.
Mobile scrolled view: local sky, timeline, keyboard focus ring on the slider, two-column metrics, and comparison action. No horizontal viewport overflow.

limits: Software tests are not independent scientific validation.
No screen-reader session was performed; programmatic labels and text equivalents were inspected.
Reduced-motion CSS was checked; OS preference emulation was not available.
